title: add benchmark-lab adaptive-batching profiling + reporting pipeline v72
author: Priya Shah
description: This PR adds the next iteration (v72) of the benchmark-lab adaptive batching work: representative workload runners, new profiling baselines for adaptive-batching and cold-start scenarios, and an end-to-end reporting pipeline that ingests profiling artifacts into the reporting DB and exposes aggregated metrics for the console.
body:
Context and motivation: We need more realistic adaptive-batching experiments that capture cold-start behavior, KV-cache hit patterns, and multi-variant throughput/latency tradeoffs. This PR wires up representative runners, updates baseline profiles, and ships an ETL path from profiling artifacts to the reporting DB used by benchmark dashboards.

What changed: consolidated adaptive-batching runner (python) that can replay representative workloads with configurable arrival distributions; new profiling baseline YAMLs for cold-start, short-session, and long-session workloads; Airflow DAG + CI job to kick off nightly profiling runs; small runtime shim to emit additional tags (batch_size_hint, kv_cache_hit) used by the reporting pipeline; ETL script to parse profiling JSONs and write aggregated rows to reporting DB; dashboard query and example report template.

Checklist:
- [x] representative workload runner implemented (benchlab/runners/adaptive_runner.py)
- [x] profiling baselines added (benchlab/profiles/v72/*.yaml)
- [x] reporting ETL and Airflow DAG added (infra/airflow/dags/benchlab_reporting_v72.py)
- [x] CI job to run quick smoke profiling on PRs (ci/benchlab_smoke.yml)
- [x] unit tests for ETL parsing and runner harness (tests/benchlab/*)
- [x] docs updated (docs/benchlab/README.md)

Notes and constraints:
- The ETL writes to the existing reporting DB schema; for safety the DAG runs in dry-run mode by default and CI uses the local sqlite runner. Production ingestion requires a one-line flag in infra/airflow/secrets to enable.
- The runtime shim adds lightweight telemetry only; we've gated it behind a feature flag (REDWOOD_BENCHLAB_TAGGING).

Related work and tickets: ENG-4821 (adaptive batching experiment infra), ENG-4890 (reporting pipeline for profiling).

review_comments: Daniel Kim (2024-11-06): Left a few nits on the ETL parser regarding error handling when encountering truncated profiles. Can we fail-fast in the CI job but be tolerant in nightly runs?

Lena Ortiz (2024-11-08): The runner looks good overall. Suggest adding an option to simulate heavy KV-cache churn (batches with varying cache hit ratios).
Priya Shah (2024-11-08): Added --kv-cache-churn flag and a small utility to randomize hit ratios per session.
Marco Alvarez (2024-11-09): CI flake: benchlab_smoke timed out on ubuntu-20.04 matrix. Can we reduce the runtime for smoke and add a retry?
Priya Shah (2024-11-09): Reduced smoke runtime and added single retry. Reran CI and green.
